request.question: My keyboard types @ when I press the quote key and I can't find the pound sign.
request.answer: If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. 1. Open Settings > Time & language > Language & region. 2. Set the keyboard to "United Kingdom"
claims: If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK.
1. Open Settings > Time & language > Language & region.

documents.text:
## Fix
If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. On Windows open **Settings > Time & language > Language & region** and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". On a Mac open **System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources** and add "British".
